title: Crack Burger on the Recteq Smokestone
description: A delicious and addictive burger recipe cooked on the Recteq Smokestone, featuring bacon, cheddar cheese, and a flavorful seasoning mix.
steps: Cook the bacon until crispy and shred it.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, ranch seasoning, sour cream, shredded bacon, and shredded cheddar cheese. Mix thoroughly with your hands.
Portion the mixture into approximately 4-ounce balls. Use a kitchen scale for accuracy if desired.
Form each portion into a semi-smash patty on the grill, seasoning one side with SPG (salt, pepper, garlic powder).
Flip the patties and place a slice of Kobe Jack cheese on each.
Assemble the burgers by placing the patties on the buns and adding Heinz 57 sauce and any additional toppings.
notes:
Adjust toppings and condiments to taste.
